def mvcc.api.sent.regAgree (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fs : List
    (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (lo : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ w, S.ws !! id = some w ∧ w.rg = rg ∧ w.fs = fs ∧ w.lo = lo

theorem mvcc.api.sent.recvEvs_snoc (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (id : w64) :
    mvcc.api.recvEvs (rs ++ [r]) id = mvcc.api.recvEvs rs id ++ if r.id = id then r.evs else []

structure mvcc.api.sent.SentFact : Type where
  r : mvcc.api.WResp
  rg : mvcc.WatchRange
  fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)
  lo : Nat
  L : mvcc.Log
  c0 : Int
  cov : List mvcc.api.sent.CovEntry
  dead : List w64

structure mvcc.api.sent.CovEntry : Type where
  id : w64
  rg : mvcc.WatchRange
  fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)
  lo : Nat

theorem mvcc.api.sent.deliv_of_sent (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (F : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : mvcc.api.sent.sentChain F → mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ F →
    mvcc.api.sent.registryAgree S F → ∀ (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo), S.ws !! id = some w →
    mvcc.api.onceUpTo σ.notifiedLog w.lo σ.crev → ∃ hi, hi ≤ List.length σ.notifiedLog ∧
    mvcc.api.recvEvs (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r F) id = mvcc.filtered w.fs (mvcc.watchEvents
    σ.notifiedLog w.rg w.lo hi)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.SentInv.close {σ : mvcc.api.MvccState} {S : mvcc.api.StreamState} {D : List
    w64} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S.close D F

theorem mvcc.api.sent.commit_mono (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (hr : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ) :
    σ.notifiedLog <+: σ.commitPending.notifiedLog ∧ σ.crev ≤ σ.commitPending.crev

theorem mvcc.api.sent.cancel_lookup (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (id i : w64) : ∃ g, (∀ (w :
    mvcc.api.WInfo), (g w).rg = w.rg ∧ (g w).fs = w.fs ∧ (g w).lo = w.lo ∧ (g w).k = w.k) ∧
    (S.cancel id).ws !! i = Option.map g (S.ws !! i) ∧ (i = id → ∀ (w : mvcc.api.WInfo), (S.cancel
    id).ws !! i = some w → w.live = false) ∧ (i ≠ id → (S.cancel id).ws !! i = S.ws !! i)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sentChain_snoc (G : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact)
    : mvcc.api.sent.sentChain (G ++ [f]) ↔ mvcc.api.sent.sentChain G ∧ mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.holds
    (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r G) f

def mvcc.api.sent.deadIn (D : List w64) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact), f ∈ F → ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ f.dead → id ∈ D

def mvcc.api.sent.stampsAt (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (j : Nat) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop
    :=
  f.r.id = W64 (-1) →
    ∀ (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo), S.ws !! id = some w → w.k ≤ j → (∃ c, c ∈ f.cov ∧ c.id = id) ∨ id ∈ f.dead

theorem mvcc.api.sent.reach_pending_ne_nil (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.MvccReachable σ →
    σ.pending ≠ some []

theorem mvcc.api.sent.SentInv.step {σ σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState} {S : mvcc.api.StreamState} {D : List
    w64} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) (hl : σ.notifiedLog
    <+: σ'.notifiedLog) (hc : σ.crev ≤ σ'.crev) : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ' S D F

theorem mvcc.api.sent.notify_mono (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hp : σ.pending
    = none) : σ.notifiedLog <+: (σ.notify pend).notifiedLog ∧ σ.crev ≤ (σ.notify pend).crev

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sentFacts_snoc (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (D : List
    w64) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ
    S D F) (hf : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.holds (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r F) f) (hlb : f.L
    <+: σ.notifiedLog ∧ f.c0 ≤ σ.crev) (hag : mvcc.api.sent.factAgree S f) (hdi : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈
    f.dead → id ∈ D) (hst : mvcc.api.sent.stampsAt S F.length f) : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D (F ++
    [f])

theorem mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk_mono {σ σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (hl :
    σ.notifiedLog <+: σ'.notifiedLog) (hc : σ.crev ≤ σ'.crev) (h : mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ F) :
    mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ' F

def mvcc.api.sent.sentChain (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact),
    F[j]? = some f → mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.holds (List.take j (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r F)) f

structure mvcc.api.sent.SentInv (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (D : List w64)
  (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop where
  chain : mvcc.api.sent.sentChain F
  lbs : mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ F
  reg : mvcc.api.sent.registryAgree S F
  dead : mvcc.api.sent.deadMono S D
  deadIn : mvcc.api.sent.deadIn D F
  stamps : mvcc.api.sent.stampsRecorded S F

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sentInv_nil (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ
    mvcc.api.wsStart [] []

theorem mvcc.api.sent.restore_mono (σ σ' : mvcc.api.MvccState) (hp : σ.pending = none) (hp' :
    σ'.pending = none) (hl : σ.log <+: σ'.log) (hc : σ.crev ≤ σ'.crev) : σ.notifiedLog <+:
    σ'.notifiedLog ∧ σ.crev ≤ σ'.crev

theorem mvcc.api.sent.SentInv.register {σ : mvcc.api.MvccState} {S : mvcc.api.StreamState} {D : List
    w64} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) (id : w64) (w :
    mvcc.api.WInfo) (hnone : S.ws !! id = none) (hneg : id ≠ W64 (-1)) (hk : F.length ≤ w.k) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ (S.register id w) D F

def mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.holds (pre : List mvcc.api.WResp) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop :=
  mvcc.api.sent.respShape f.r f.L f.c0 ∧
    (f.r.id ≠ W64 (-1) →
        mvcc.api.onceUpTo f.L f.lo f.c0 →
          ∃ hi,
            hi ≤ List.length f.L ∧
              mvcc.api.recvEvs (pre ++ [f.r]) f.r.id = mvcc.filtered f.fs (mvcc.watchEvents f.L f.rg f.lo hi)) ∧
      (f.r.id ≠ W64 (-1) →
          f.r.evs = [] →
            f.r.compactRev = W64 0 →
              mvcc.api.onceUpTo f.L f.lo f.c0 →
                mvcc.api.recvEvs (pre ++ [f.r]) f.r.id =
                  mvcc.filtered f.fs (mvcc.watchEvents f.L f.rg f.lo (sint.nat f.r.rev + 1))) ∧
        (f.r.id = W64 (-1) →
            ∀ (c : mvcc.api.sent.CovEntry),
              c ∈ f.cov →
                mvcc.api.onceUpTo f.L c.lo f.c0 →
                  mvcc.api.recvEvs (pre ++ [f.r]) c.id =
                    mvcc.filtered c.fs (mvcc.watchEvents f.L c.rg c.lo (sint.nat f.r.rev + 1))) ∧
          (f.r.evs = [] →
            f.r.compactRev = W64 0 →
              (f.r.id ≠ W64 (-1) → ↑f.lo ≤ sint.Z f.r.rev + 1) ∧
                (f.r.id = W64 (-1) → ∀ (c : mvcc.api.sent.CovEntry), c ∈ f.cov → ↑c.lo ≤ sint.Z f.r.rev + 1) ∧
                  ∀ (y : mvcc.api.WResp), y ∈ pre → y.evs = [] → sint.Z y.rev ≤ sint.Z f.r.rev)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.wsRecvOk_of_sent (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (D : List
    w64) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : (∀ (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact), f ∈ F → f.L <+:
    σ.notifiedLog ∧ f.c0 ≤ σ.crev) → mvcc.api.sent.sentChain F → mvcc.api.sent.registryAgree S F →
    mvcc.api.sent.deadMono S D → mvcc.api.sent.deadIn D F → mvcc.api.sent.stampsRecorded S F →
    mvcc.api.wsRecvOk σ S (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r F)

def mvcc.api.sent.stampsRecorded (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop
    :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact), F[j]? = some f → mvcc.api.sent.stampsAt S j f

def mvcc.api.sent.registryAgree (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop
    :=
  S.ws !! W64 (-1) = none ∧ ∀ (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact), f ∈ F → mvcc.api.sent.factAgree S f

theorem mvcc.api.sent.SentInv.take {σ : mvcc.api.MvccState} {S : mvcc.api.StreamState} {D : List
    w64} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) (n : Nat) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D (List.take n F)

def mvcc.api.sent.respShape (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (L : mvcc.Log) (c0 : Int) : Prop :=
  (∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM), ev ∈ r.evs → sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ≤ sint.Z r.rev) ∧
    (r.compactRev = W64 0 → sint.nat r.rev < List.length L) ∧
      (r.compactRev ≠ W64 0 →
          r.evs = [] ∧ r.id ≠ W64 (-1) ∧ r.rev = W64 0 ∧ 0 < sint.Z r.compactRev ∧ sint.Z r.compactRev ≤ c0) ∧
        (r.id = W64 (-1) → r.evs = [] ∧ r.compactRev = W64 0 ∧ 1 ≤ sint.Z r.rev) ∧
          ∀ (ev : mvcc.EvM),
            ev ∈ r.evs →
              0 < sint.Z ev.kv.modRev ∧ (ev.del = false → 0 < sint.Z ev.kv.createRev ∧ 0 < sint.Z ev.kv.version)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.recvEvs_nil' (id : w64) : mvcc.api.recvEvs [] id = []

def mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact), f ∈ F → f.L <+: σ.notifiedLog ∧ f.c0 ≤ σ.crev

theorem mvcc.api.sent.compact_mono (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (r : Int) (hr : σ.crev < r) :
    σ.notifiedLog <+: (σ.compactTo r).notifiedLog ∧ σ.crev ≤ (σ.compactTo r).crev

theorem mvcc.api.sent.SentInv.cancel {σ : mvcc.api.MvccState} {S : mvcc.api.StreamState} {D : List
    w64} {F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact} (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) (id : w64) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ (S.cancel id) (if (S.ws !! id).isSome = true then id :: D else D) F

theorem mvcc.api.sent.onceUpTo_mono {L L' : mvcc.Log} {lo : Nat} {c c' : Int} (hp : L <+: L') (hc :
    c ≤ c') (h : mvcc.api.onceUpTo L' lo c') : mvcc.api.onceUpTo L lo c

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sentChain_take (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) (n : Nat) (h :
    mvcc.api.sent.sentChain F) : mvcc.api.sent.sentChain (List.take n F)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.wsRecvOk_of_sent' (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (D :
    List w64) (F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) (h : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ S D F) :
    mvcc.api.wsRecvOk σ S (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r F)

theorem mvcc.api.sent.snoc_induction.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} {P : List α → Prop} (nil : P []) (snoc : ∀
    (l : List α) (a : α), P l → P (l ++ [a])) (l : List α) : P l

def mvcc.api.sent.deadMono (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (D : List w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ D → ∃ w, S.ws !! id = some w ∧ w.live = false

def mvcc.api.sent.factAgree (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (f : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact) : Prop :=
  (f.r.id ≠ W64 (-1) → mvcc.api.sent.regAgree S f.r.id f.rg f.fs f.lo) ∧
    (f.r.id = W64 (-1) → ∀ (c : mvcc.api.sent.CovEntry), c ∈ f.cov → mvcc.api.sent.regAgree S c.id c.rg c.fs c.lo)
